Definition: from G4832; to render like, i.e. (figuratively) to assimilate:--make conformable unto.
BiblicalUsage: Paul longs to know Christ and the power of His resurrection and the fellowship of His sufferings, being made conformable unto His death. Conformity to Christ is not a shape I put on but a death I share, and the resurrection power comes through it.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that knowing Christ means sharing both His suffering and His death, and I believe the power of His resurrection is found on the far side of that conformity.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
